messages:
elaine: putting a draft one-pager together for enterprise buyers — target: field and sales kit. focus: security controls, SLA tiers, and deploy-mode decision help. want it to be skimmable (quick bullets + 3 visuals).

mike: love that. for SLAs we should call out typical latency SLOs and commit tiers (standard/priority/reserved). keep numbers conservative.

raj: for deploy modes, include a tiny diagram: Hosted / Dedicated / Private and 1 line pros/cons each. also add callouts about KMS/HSM and VPC peering.

sofia: inbound routing rule: if compliance or KMS requested -> route to enterprise SDRs. otherwise MQL path. also add a checkbox: "requires private data handling".

james: benchmark narrative idea: one callout box showing 99th p50/p95 latency and $/1M tokens comparison against self-host baseline. short, not a full report. people want quick numbers to cite in sales convos.

elaine: yes — benchmark box should be a single-row table: p50 / p95 / cost per 1M tokens. no heavy charts.

laura: can do a 3-panel layout — cover (value prop), middle (deploy modes + SLA), back (bench + routing + CTA). I can send a wire by EOD tomorrow.

raj: wording for security bullets: "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), VPC/Private Connect, audit logs & SIEM exporter, SOC2/ISO summaries." short phrases.

mike: add a short note about rollouts + fallback: "Canary rollouts + automatic fallback to compatible model variant to preserve availability." useful for platform teams.

sofia: CTA variations for field: 1) Book dedicated demo 2) Request security checklist 3) Start private trial. we should A/B which CTA appears first for enterprise inbound.

elaine: assigns: laura — design sample, mike — SLA copy, raj — security line items, sofia/james — routing + CTA language. i’ll assemble and iterate. deadline: draft by 1966001260 (tomorrow afternoon).

launch-bot: Reminder created: marketing/enterprise-onepager-draft due 1966001260. :bell:

james: for webinar tie-in — propose a 30-min "Secure Inference at Scale" webinar 2 weeks after launch. the one-pager can be the registrant followup asset.

elaine: good call. add a micro-plan: social post (30s blurb), email to inbound list, webinar follow-up with one-pager. keep messaging consistent: predictable performance, cost controls, enterprise-grade security. :thumbsup:
